arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Justice Alito noted two arguments: mandatory dismissal or wrong standard.
Justice Kennedy asked why defendants have a stronger interest in seals.
Justice Ginsburg asked if the government can waive the seal condition.
Justice Kennedy asked if the advocate sought sanctions other than dismissal.
